title: Science 基础风格
caption: SciencePlots 默认：细刻度朝内、上下左右都有刻度、蓝绿橙红紫灰六色循环
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import scienceplots

plt.style.use(['science', 'no-latex'])
plt.figure(figsize=(3.5, 2.6))
plt.plot(x, y, marker='o', label='Ours')
plt.xlabel('Phase (rad)'); plt.ylabel('Amplitude')
plt.legend()
plt.savefig('fig.pdf', bbox_inches='tight')  # 投稿用矢量图
